📦 **SCP_Core `a8a0e87`** — fix(library): preserve reader projection after safe write recovery

Use a non-destructive overwrite fallback when Windows rejects File.Replace, and recognize a narrowly defined interrupted first-round write so retrying it does not fabricate a reread.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

Windows can reject File.Replace after a chapter round and its index are already durable, leaving reader progress behind and making a retry look like a genuine r2. This is local I/O recovery rather than a separate product decision; the fallback preserves the old destination on failure, and the retry path only reuses an identical same-day r1 whose reader projection is demonstrably still behind.

👥 參與者：@Sirius
